teacher_info.introduction:
About me:
I am an experienced English teacher from South Africa with a BA degree in Media, Communication and Culture and a TEFL certificate. Coming from South Africa where we have 11 official languages I understand the difficulties of learning a new language.

About my sessions:
*Informal Tutoring:
These sessions are conversation practice (helpful for improving confidence) with corrections and feedback on areas such as; grammar, vocabulary and pronunciation. I can also provide materials such as; articles or videos to encourage conversations (this is also great for picking up new vocabulary).

*Exam preparation, CAE, IELTS & TOEFL:
These sessions are generally focus on speaking and writing. They include samples of the exam questions and detailed feedback and suggestions on how to improve. Reading and Listening sections can either be done as homework or during sessions if necessary.

*Grammar:
These sessions are to work on specific grammar structures such as; articles, conditionals, prepositions, verb tenses and word order. Please be sure to send me a message letting me know which structures you would like to work on when scheduling a session. If you think you need to improve your grammar but am not sure which structures need work start off with a 30 minute trial session.

*Vocabulary:
We can work on specific vocabulary such as descriptive language, idioms or phrasal verbs. Additionally, if you think your vocabulary needs work overall we could use the sessions to use alternatives  to commonly over-used vocabulary.

*Formal English/ Preparing for a job interview:
These sessions are used to work on business language used in presentations and meetings and well as writing professional emails and CVs. If you are preparing for a job interview we can do a simulation and I will provide feedback and suggestions. 

*Comprehension:
These sessions are to practice reading and listening skills by completing comprehension tests to work on vocabulary and reading/listening skills.

If you can't attend a session please, try to reschedule via 24 hours in advance.

course_info.trial_description: In the trial session we start by identifying your goals, strengths and weakness. I will try to help you decide which type session will suit you and come up with a study plan.

pro_course_detail.title: General Conversation Practice
pro_course_detail.description: In these sessions we will focus on conversational skills, and I will provide corrections  (verbally and in writing) and suggestions where necessary. We can also use materials such as articles and texts for variety of topics and to introduce new vocabulary.

pro_course_detail.title: Grammar lessons
pro_course_detail.description: These sessions are to work on specific grammar structures such as; articles, conditionals, prepositions, verb tenses and word order. Please be sure to send me a message letting me know which structures you would like to work on when scheduling a session. If you think you need to improve your grammar but am not sure which structures you need to work on start off with a 30 minute trial session.

pro_course_detail.title: FCE, CAE, IELTS & TOEFLexam preparation
pro_course_detail.description:
These sessions are to prepare for exams such as FCE, CAE, IELTS and TOEFL  (if you'd like to prepare for another type of exam please send a message specifying which exam and I'll let you know if I would feel confident helping you). 
Usually I like to use sample tests to practice with you, while introducing more complex grammar (such as conditionals, various clause types and perfect tenses) as well as advanced vocabulary (like phrasal verbs, idioms and descriptive language). I tend to mostly focus on speaking in these sessions but also use them to review writing tasks.

pro_course_detail.title: Job Interview Preparation & Business English
pro_course_detail.description:
Are you preparing for a job interview? In these sessions we'll go through some common job interview questions, and I'll provide feedback and suggestions.
Do you need to improve your professional English? In these lessons we can work on skills needed for emails, meetings, presentations and negotiations.
